cost_model: Dynamic credits; docs say most runs use 'a few hundred credits'; capped by maxCredits 1000. At $0.001-$0.005/credit = $0.30-$5.00 at the cap. 5 free runs/day.

effort.note: Docs list low/medium/high (spark-2 only) without describing what each changes or recommending one for research.

maxCredits.note: Our cap, not a vendor recommendation; 2026-09 used 100, below the documented typical run.

agent dynamic billing, 5 free daily runs
